title: Lux 20 Guest w/ Pickle, Pool, & More
description:
Welcome to The Desert Pearl, your ultimate Phoenix area retreat! Bring the whole family and more! 

This luxury home sleeps up to 20 guests with 10 comfy beds and stunning designer décor. Enjoy resort-style amenities—pool, spa, basketball and pickleball courts, plus a pool table for endless fun. Located near top restaurants and shops, just 25 minutes from PHX Airport and 28 minutes from downtown Phoenix. Perfect for families, groups, and unforgettable getaways!

 The space 
Our property was finished in a way that provides a great family and friend retreat. We take great care and pride in the property, and we expect the same from our guests.

Chandler is a great city in Arizona with a lot of restaurants and activities. With nearby access to the city of Phoenix, you have the calm and luxury without the bustling busy city life.

We have 7 bedrooms plus a king sized bedroom loft on the second floor for a total of 10 beds. 5 bedrooms include an en suite bathroom. 
Of the 7 bedrooms, 5 have king sized beds and 2 bedrooms have two queen beds, for a total of 6 king sized beds and 4 queen sized beds, when including the loft. 

Our property also includes a newly installed pickleball and basketball court as well as putting and chipping green along our great outdoor area. Each TV is logged in to Netflix, Hulu + LiveTV, Disney+, Espn, HBO Max, and Paramount+ for your enjoyment!

The hot tub can be heated for an additional fee during your stay. Please let us know if you are interested in having the hot tub heated!

 Guest access 
We provide access through our Schlage lock system. It will assign you a code that you will be sent/emailed before you check in and will be good starting at your check in time until right after your check out time.

 Other things to note 
We have cameras on the EXTERIOR of our property, and in no way are they in an area that takes away from your privacy. We also have one in the garage to watch our vehicles that we have there. 

If you have any questions, please feel free to reach out, as we are happy and willing to answer.
